title: The onboarding checklist
objectives: Complete every item on the onboarding checklist.
Show the riskometer and match it to the profile.
Record the recommendation and the reason.
body_md:
- ☐ KYC verified (status validated, not on hold)
- ☐ FATCA / CRS declaration completed
- ☐ Holding mode chosen deliberately (single, joint, either or survivor)
- ☐ Nomination registered, or opt-out formally recorded
- ☐ Bank mandate set up for SIPs
- ☐ Riskometer of each scheme shown and matched to the client's profile
- ☐ Exit load, lock-in and expense ratio explained
- ☐ Commission and direct-plan option disclosed
- ☐ Recommendation and reason recorded in the client file

> **Investor takeaway:** Know what you own, why you own it, and what it costs before you invest.
example: Before a first SIP, you confirm KYC is validated, the nominee is registered, the mandate is set, and you show the scheme's riskometer. You note the reason in the file: 'Flexi cap for a 7-year goal, Moderately High risk, client accepts a 20% fall.'
say: This fund suits your 7-year goal. It can fall 20% in a bad year. Are you comfortable staying invested if that happens?
Let me explain the exit load and the costs before you sign.
never: Skip the nominee, you can add it later.
Don't worry about the exit load.

talk_track.title: The onboarding checklist
talk_track.text: Before the first rupee goes in, run this checklist. KYC verified and not on hold. FATCA declaration done. Holding mode chosen deliberately: single, joint, or either or survivor. A nominee registered, or the opt-out formally recorded. Bank mandate set up for SIPs. The riskometer of each scheme shown and matched to the client's profile. Exit load, lock-in and expense ratio explained. Commission and the direct-plan option disclosed. And the reason for the recommendation recorded in the client file. Then set expectations honestly: "This fund suits your seven-year goal. It can fall 20% in a bad year. Are you comfortable staying invested if that happens?"

check.q: Which is NOT part of the onboarding checklist?
o: Riskometer matched to the client's profile
check.why: Returns are never guaranteed. Promising them is a compliance breach.

check.q: Why is a nominee registered at onboarding?
o: It is optional and has no effect
It makes transmission to the family much faster after death
It is needed only for SIPs
check.why: Nomination makes transmission much faster, so register one or record the opt-out.

check.q: A client's KYC shows 'on hold'. What should you do?
o: Resolve the KYC status before investing
check.why: KYC must be verified, with status validated and not on hold, before investing.
